Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it: the 300 included sandbox logins from their May rollout, and 280 is the active production roster as of Jul 1. Ruth confirmed 280 in the same thread.

That's his July figure, so check the current roster before it goes in the pod sheet.
